reviews.text: We found Nick because of his and Jeff's catchy videos on Instagram, and something about their personalities and the way they presented themselves made me think, “I have to call these guys!” I’m so glad we did. Selling our first home was a big deal for us, and naturally, I had a lot of questions. Nick was professional, knowledgeable, incredibly responsive, and truly there for us every step of the way. Anytime something came up, he was always ready with a solution and never made us feel like we were bothering him. He was patient, reassuring, and made what could have been a very stressful process feel so much easier. I know he had other clients and was busy, but honestly, you would never have known it. He always made us feel like we were his only clients because he responded so quickly and was always available when we needed him. From our first conversation to closing, Nick went above and beyond. We couldn’t have asked for a better person to guide us through selling our first home. If you’re looking for a realtor who genuinely cares about his clients and will be there every step of the way, I highly recommend Nick!
